task: Response-control map exploration: from A0G-A0P results, build a training-dynamics response matrix over optimizer/external control inputs. NOT an algorithm-design round: find which input channel carries a physically stable, optimization-meaningful response. Outputs: response matrix J=[LR, clip, WD]; which channel has stable response; which channel is the better future control variable. Target: a physical input channel, not a scheduler.

lr.analytic_source: A0O-validated: h_lr = sum_k <p_th^{(k)}, lr_k*e_lr(k)>, e_lr = -adaptive(c_k) - wd*theta_k (frozen a0o.lr_pulse, import-only)

clip.analytic_source: h_clip = sum_k tau0 * <b_k, ghat_k> * 1[preclip_norm_k > tau0], where ghat_k = native_gradient_k/preclip_norm_k, b_k = cotangent_dc entering the frozen clip transpose at iter k (clip is active iff preclip_norm > tau0; clipped = g*min(1,tau/||g||) so d clipped/d tau = ghat when active, else 0; d tau/du = tau0 at u=0)

wd.parameterization: u = log(lambda/lambda0), lambda0 = 0.01 (native AdamW default, stored in v0.2 bank state)
wd.analytic_source: pure theta channel (m/v unaffected by wd in AdamW): h_wd = sum_k <p_th^{(k)}, -lr_k*lambda0*theta_k>, theta_k = snapshot theta_start; wd(u)=lambda0*e^u persists across steps natively (unlike lr it is not rewritten per micro-step)

perturbation_structure: PERSISTENT over the H=4 window (u applied at EVERY optimizer step k=1..4), identical semantics to the A0O-validated FD reference. H=4 chosen because A0P showed first-order kernels break down at long lag; H=4 is the production horizon validated in A0O/A0K/A0L/A0N.

state_and_stream.stream_content_recipe: batch_seed = derive_stream_seed(stream_seed, 404); batches = batches_from_train_pool(train_indices(3936), batch_size=4, batch_seed, 8 micro-batches = 4 steps x accum 2). Identical across channels and branches (CRN).
state_and_stream.provenance_gate: A0O amendment-A1 pattern: A0K live_manifest event key must exist (2030/2031 -> own seed, 2037 -> 2032, step -> largest multiple of 10 <= step); content NOT reused.

stage1_gate.scope: per channel, pooled over 12 cells (n=12 analytic-vs-FD pairs per channel)
stage1_gate.precedent: A0O/A0P stage-1 gate thresholds, reused frozen
stage1_gate.on_channel_fail: channel reported as NOT validated for that criterion; no relaunch, no delta change, no threshold change; round continues to report all channels

stage2_evaluation.response_magnitude: median |h_i| per channel over 12 cells + magnitude normalized to the LR channel
stage2_evaluation.sign_stability: fraction of the 12 cells whose sign(h_i) equals the channel majority sign
stage2_evaluation.cross_seed_consistency: per-seed median h_i (sign + magnitude); sign agreement across the 3 seeds; CV of |h_i| across the 12 cells
stage2_evaluation.fd_agreement: gate metrics per channel (Pearson, sign accuracy, rel err median)

response_matrix: J[cell] = [h_lr, h_clip, h_wd] (analytic, FD-validated); reported for all 12 cells with the FD counterparts; no cell or channel dropped
stable_channel_rule_pre_registered: A channel is STABLE iff it passes its stage-1 gate (|Pearson|>=0.8 AND sign>=0.9). Among stable channels, the better future control variable is the one with (a) larger median |h| and (b) sign stability >= 2/3 and (c) cross-seed sign agreement = 3/3. This rule is frozen BEFORE any GPU; ties reported without selection.
forbidden: no controller / no closed-loop runner / no algorithm design
no lambda tuning, no optimizer body change, no scheduler change (perturbation branches touch only the named scalar input per channel)
no delta change, no channel addition/removal based on results, no state/stream selection based on results
A0O/A0P and all earlier frozen artifacts read-only; docs append-only
no GPU work before this contract + live_manifest hash notes exist on disk
outputs: outputs/a0q_response_control_map_v01/ (contract/ runs/ analysis/ reports/A0Q_REPORT.md hashes/ audit/); code research/src/fr/a0q_response_control_map_v01.py + research/scripts/a0q_{run,analyze,audit_pack}_v01.py
stop_rule: One stage: all 12 cells x 3 channels -> per-channel gates -> evaluation -> report -> STOP. Do not auto-launch any next round.
